Ellington Management Group Continues to Hold Stake in Norfolk Southern (NSC); Edwards Lifesciences Corpora (EW) Holding Boosted by Kames Capital Plc 
March 23, 2018 - By Louis Casey 
Mike Vranos increased its stake in Norfolk Southern Corp (NSC) by 150% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Ellington Management Group Llc bought 2,700 shares as the company’s stock declined 7.75% while stock markets rallied. The hedge fund run by Mike Vranos held 4,500 shares of the railroads company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $595,000, up from 1,800 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Ellington Management Group Llc who had been investing in Norfolk Southern Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $38.52 billion market cap company.
